method.score: Full native compositions with ordinary automatic balance, float32 48 kHz stereo, no render tail.
method.selection: One fixed candidate; no learned-score search or candidate selection.
method.cohort: Nine declared preset seeds for learned scores; independent seed 501 for four affected presets checks PCM safety and written-score invariance only.
method.signal: Whole-song stereo RMS/peak/crest and mono Welch PSD, 4096-sample windows, fraction of power at or above 2 kHz.
method.audition: First chorus, ten seconds, shared stereo RMS target -20 dBFS reduced if either peak would exceed 0.8; PCM16.
method.windows_cache: Serial huggingface_hub.are_symlinks_supported checks before official snapshot worker downloads; unchanged evaluator and pinned model code.

learned_before.interpretation: TuneJury uncalibrated preference reward (empty prompt); MuQ-MuLan identity cosines, not probability.

prompts.purpose: Fixed descriptions of preset identity. Similarity is not musical quality or probability. Freeze this file before comparing renders.
